title: Invariant for the empty gate list
statement: For any natural numbers $n$ and $c$ and any gate property $P$, the empty gate list with the identity map on the $n$ input vertices satisfies the rewriting invariant: the map has length $n$, each input maps to a valid vertex, the rewritten list is acyclic and has length zero, and the mapped values and depths satisfy the invariant bounds; every gate in the rewritten list satisfies $P$.
